data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Zahar', meaning 'Golden, Radiant, Bright'. In the Bible, the name Zahar is associated with the high priest's mantle which was golden and shining. A beautiful, radiant name for a baby girl. The name Zaharina carries the meaning “Golden, Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zaharina usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zaharina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: זחארינה
in_hebrew.meaning: זחארינה - מיוחדת, מלכה, נזר ה' היא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זחארינה היא שם עברי שמקורו מהשם זכריה, שפירושו 'ה' זכר' או 'זכר ה''. השם Zaharina הוא גרסה נשית של השם, שיכולה להתפרש כ'מיוחדת לה'', 'מלכה של ה'', או 'נזר ה'' היא. השם מופיע במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד, ויש לו קונוטציות של ייחוד, מלכות וקדושה.

in_greek.name: Ζαχαρίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ζαχαρίνα είναι η γυναικεία μορφή του ονόματος Ζαχαρίας, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός θυμάται' ή 'μνήμη του Θεού'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ζαχαρίνα έχει συσχετιστεί με έννοιες όπως η ιδιαίτερη σχέση με το Θεό, η βασιλεία και η αγιότητα. Στο Ευαγγέλιο, ο Ζαχαρίας είναι ο πατέρας του Ιωάννη του Βαπτίστη.

in_latin.name: Zacharina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zacharina est forma feminina nominis Zacharias, quod significat 'Deus recordatur' vel 'memoria Dei'. In traditione ecclesiastica, nomen Zacharina coniunctum est cum notionibus specialitatis, regni et sanctitatis. In Scriptura, Zacharias est pater Ioannis Baptistae.

in_english.name: Zaharina
in_english.meaning: Zaharina - a special one, queen of God, or crown of the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaharina is derived from the Hebrew name Zachariah, meaning 'God remembers' or 'memory of God'. As a feminine form, Zaharina connotes being a special one, a queen of God, or a crown of the Lord. It carries spiritual significance, reflecting a unique relationship with God and attributes of royalty and sanctity. Historically, the name has been used in both Jewish and Christian traditions, symbolizing a deep connection to faith and divine remembrance.

This name is a symbol of the values such as beauty, grace, strength, and purity.

Embodying the qualities of golden, radiant, and bright, Zaharina is believed to be a connection to the divine and a reminder of the light that resides within all of us.
